description: Analytics dashboard, attention widget, dashboard integration, and export/bulk-actions polish
steps: Create src/components/tracker/AnalyticsDashboard.tsx - Shows conversion funnel visualization (how many jobs at each stage, conversion rates between stages), average time-in-stage chart, and weekly/monthly application velocity. Uses data from GET /api/tracker/analytics.

Create src/components/tracker/AttentionWidget.tsx - Shows items needing action: overdue follow-ups (past due date), stale applications (>14 days without an event), upcoming interviews (next 7 days). Each item is clickable to open the detail drawer. Uses data from GET /api/tracker/attention.
Add Analytics section to the tracker page (src/app/tracker/page.tsx) as a fourth tab or integrated section

Update src/app/page.tsx (dashboard) to include: a pipeline stats card showing active applications count by stage, and the AttentionWidget showing urgent items. Import data from /api/tracker/pipeline and /api/tracker/attention. Handle the case where the tracker has no data gracefully.
Add bulk actions to ListView.tsx: select multiple jobs via checkboxes, then bulk-update status, bulk-archive (set to closed), or bulk-delete. Add a toolbar that appears when items are selected.

Add CSV export button to ListView.tsx: exports currently visible/filtered jobs as CSV with columns (title, company, status, applied date, priority, next action, salary). Use client-side CSV generation with Blob download.

Polish drag-and-drop in PipelineBoard.tsx: add visual feedback during drag (ghost card, drop zone highlighting with dashed border), smooth transitions, and proper ARIA live announcements for screen readers when cards are moved
Add keyboard accessibility to PipelineBoard: allow cards to be moved between columns using keyboard shortcuts (e.g., Ctrl+Arrow Left/Right to move to adjacent column)
Ensure all new components handle loading states (skeleton placeholders), error states (using extractErrorMessage), and empty states
Add unit tests in src/lib/__tests__/tracker-analytics.test.ts for analytics calculation utilities (conversion rate calculation, time-in-stage averaging, attention item detection logic)
acceptance_criteria: Analytics dashboard shows conversion funnel and time-in-stage data
Attention widget correctly identifies overdue follow-ups and stale applications
Main dashboard (/) shows pipeline stats and attention widget
Bulk actions work in list view (multi-select, bulk status change, bulk archive, bulk delete)
CSV export downloads a valid CSV file with correct headers and data
Drag-and-drop has visual feedback (drop zones, ghost cards)
Keyboard navigation works for moving cards between columns
